limitations.note: The rewrite aligned the two comparisons but moved detection one clock earlier by checking the window that includes the incoming bit instead of preserving the existing registered check of the stored window.
Changing the reset value from all zeros to all ones suppressed startup matches that the original zero-filled register could produce.
The test checked the just-shifted window and required nine post-reset samples, so it validated the rewrite's assumptions rather than catching the timing and startup mismatches.
